requiredLanes.label: Google Reviews (Google Travel/Hotels panel)
requiredLanes.fetchStrategy: logged-in browser (server fetch blocked) — use in-page review search + topic chips
requiredLanes.notes: Richest, most searchable corpus. Use in-panel "Search reviews" + topic chips. Filtered views cap ~10 per query — run every keyword across all three sort strategies (most_helpful, lowest_score, most_recent) and dedupe by author+date.

requiredLanes.label: TripAdvisor
requiredLanes.fetchStrategy: logged-in browser (server fetch blocked) — use in-page review search + topic chips
requiredLanes.notes: Server-side fetch is 403-blocked — logged-in browser only. Use review search + "Popular mentions" chips. The ABSENCE of entertainment from popular mentions is itself a finding worth capturing.

requiredLanes.label: Booking.com
requiredLanes.fetchStrategy: logged-in browser (server fetch blocked) — use in-page review search + topic chips
requiredLanes.notes: "Read all reviews" modal has a topic search. Structured liked/disliked fields give clean attribution. Category sub-scores (Value, Staff, etc.) are tell-tale signals. Often blocks server fetch.
plannedQueries: Caesars Republic Scottsdale Scottsdale, Arizona reviews

requiredLanes.label: Expedia
requiredLanes.fetchStrategy: logged-in browser (server fetch blocked) — use in-page review search + topic chips
requiredLanes.notes: Tends to skew more recent. Note: shares the Expedia-Group review DB with Travelocity — never count both as independent platforms in client-facing scorecards.
plannedQueries: Caesars Republic Scottsdale Scottsdale, Arizona reviews

requiredLanes.label: Reddit
requiredLanes.fetchStrategy: harvest verbatim quotes from Google "site:" result snippets (direct fetch blocked)
requiredLanes.notes: Direct fetch is usually blocked. Harvest verbatim quotes from Google "site:reddit.com" result snippets (#:~:text= fragments). Candid signal — often surfaces things review platforms hide.
plannedQueries: site:reddit.com Caesars Republic Scottsdale Scottsdale, Arizona

requiredLanes.label: YouTube (walkthroughs / vlogs)
requiredLanes.fetchStrategy: logged-in browser (server fetch blocked) — use in-page review search + topic chips
requiredLanes.notes: Walkthrough chapter titles reveal the named-venue inventory (this is how venue lists are recovered without floor plans). Titles + comments are also guest-generated signal.

requiredLanes.label: Aerial / satellite imagery + property hero photos
requiredLanes.fetchStrategy: visual inspection only (satellite/aerial + hero photos) — findings are inference, label as such
requiredLanes.notes: Read building massing for the acoustic-siting hypothesis. Cross-check venue inventory against property hero photos. Findings derived here are INFERENCE — label as such.

optionalLanes.label: Travelocity
optionalLanes.fetchStrategy: optional reference capture — do not double-count toward independent platforms
optionalLanes.notes: NOT an independent source — shares the Expedia-Group review DB. Capture only for reference; never double-count toward "platforms cross-checked".

optionalLanes.label: Travel blogs / longform guest posts
optionalLanes.fetchStrategy: logged-in browser (server fetch blocked) — use in-page review search + topic chips
optionalLanes.notes: Useful for noise/atmosphere callouts and longer-form anecdotes that capped review fields cannot hold.

themeFocus.note: The money theme — aim for ≥6 records across multiple platforms and at least one 5-star fan asking for more.
Guests asking by name for an adult-only zone / live music / late hours. 2-3 is enough; quality > volume.
Protect-this signals — named talent and format-that-works reviews.
Standout-to-scale signals. Mayan / mariachi / regional content that over-performs.
Quality ceiling / venue-sightline / thermal-fail callouts. Often 1-2 records are enough.
The engine-that-works signal. Contrasts with the after-dinner-gap.
Family-strong evidence + teen-tier-absent evidence. The segment-opportunity flank.
External spill + internal bleed + thermal. Three distinct sub-problems; cover each.
Relaunch-window timing signal. 1 representative quote is enough.

guardrails: Capture only what is actually on the live page. Never invent, paraphrase-into-existence, or "reconstruct from memory" a review, quote, rating, author, date, or URL.

Every evidence record must trace to a real, openable source URL you visited. Record provenance with `capture-record` (real --source-url, real --platform, real --captured-at) before authoring any finding.
Quotes must be verbatim from the live source. Do not tidy grammar, merge two reviews, or extend a partial quote.
Ratings/scores are copied exactly as shown ("4.6 / 5", "8.9 / 10"). Never normalize, average, or estimate a score the platform did not display.
If a source is blocked, empty, or yields nothing for a query, record that honestly (skip-with-reason or zero evidence). An empty result is a finding; a fabricated result is a firewall breach.
Do not promote a record to `live_verified` unless you personally read it on the live platform in this session. The promotion flow records HOW it was confirmed — keep that truthful.
No invented URLs. If you cannot find the property page on a platform, leave it MISSING and say so — the engine prefers a NOT READY audit over a fabricated one.
Inference (e.g. acoustic/massing hypotheses from aerial imagery) must be labeled as `inference`, never as `live_verified` guest evidence.

commandSequence.purpose: Record provenance for each artifact you captured (one per source page). Offline — only hashes the local screenshot.
Turn your authored findings (verbatim quotes + themes, tied to the captured URLs) into an evidence patch.
Merge the new evidence into the audit.
See which planned sources / theme slots / keywords still have no evidence — loop back to step 1 for the gaps.
For each record you personally confirmed on the live page, promote it to live_verified (records HOW it was confirmed).
The gate. Exit 0 = READY (teaser/deck unlock); nonzero = NOT READY — run `oseg-audit doctor caesars-republic-scottsdale` for the single next action.

readiness.definition: NOT READY: 7 required source(s) still without evidence (google, tripadvisor, booking, expedia, reddit, youtube, aerial_satellite). Capture the missing sources and re-run verify; the engine will keep the teaser/deck suppressed until this clears.
